_comment: Hoenn & Seek 2.1-07: the daily swarm (HGSS style). One row is rolled each day (src/hoenn_swarm.c);
on that map, rate % of land encounters are the swarm's species, at a level from the map's own
land table (its lowest to highest level). Announced on every TV, on the PokéGear radio (the
'daily_swarm' segment, data/hoenn/radio_segments.json) and on the SEEKER'S JOURNAL's TODAY page.
every row as a source. Land only: water and fishing swarms would need hooks in the surf and rod code.
map      map folder (data/maps/<map>), any region; it must have a land table
species  SPECIES_ name without the prefix
rate     % of the map's land encounters (HGSS: 40)
levels   optional [min, max]; default: the map's land table
Swarm-only species (2.1 plan section 3): the Galarian forms of Gen 1-3 species, which have no other
source. Rows are kept in order: the saved var holds a row's index + 1, so append new rows at the end
(a removed row would shift a saved day's swarm to its neighbour for the rest of that day, no worse).

swarms.note: Mt. Mortar's Marill come out (HGSS's Mt. Mortar swarm)
swarm-only; down the road from the Slowpoke Well
swarm-only; FRLG's Ponyta on Cycling Road
Emerald's Seedot outbreak, at the band's level
swarm-only; ghostly coral on the mountain of graves
